name: 33176 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33176 (Miami) has 212 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33176 (Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33176 (Miami) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33176 (Miami) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
